item.description: The get_domain_separator function fails with "ValueError: non-hexadecimal number found in fromhex() arg at position 1" because it's trying to process non-hex values as hex strings. The chainId parameter is not properly converted to hex before being used in the domain separator calculation.
item.contract: Function should properly handle domain parameters including chainId, converting it to hexadecimal representation before packing it into the domain separator calculation. The function must correctly process all parameters according to EIP-712 specification.

item.description: The sign_transaction function requires a chain_id keyword-only argument that is not being passed from the caller. The function signature in transaction_signatures.py expects chain_id but it's not being provided from the caller.
item.contract: The sign_transaction function should accept and properly forward the chain_id parameter from the caller to the underlying transaction signing function.

item.description: The sign_transaction function has a mismatch between its signature and expected usage. It defines chain_id as a keyword-only argument but the caller isn't passing it correctly, and the function also doesn't handle all required parameters properly.
item.contract: The sign_transaction function must properly accept chain_id as a keyword-only argument and handle transaction signing correctly with all required parameters including chain_id.

item.description: The test_max_positional_args test fails because several functions exceed the maximum of 2 positional arguments. Functions need to be updated to use keyword-only arguments using '*' in their signatures.
item.contract: Functions in the codebase must be modified to limit positional arguments to 2 maximum by using keyword-only arguments with '*' in their signatures.

item.description: The CLI subcommand examples are failing with exit codes indicating command execution errors. These appear to be related to missing or improperly configured CLI commands.
item.contract: CLI subcommands must be properly implemented and executable with correct argument handling to satisfy the test cases in test_subcommand_examples.
